meta.name: customize
meta.description: Add new capabilities or modify NanoClaw behavior. Use when user wants to add channels (Telegram, Slack, email input), change triggers, add integrations, modify the router, or make any other customizations. This is an interactive skill that asks questions to understand what the user wants.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扩展 NanoClaw,接入新渠道、调整触发与路由。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想按需扩展 NanoClaw 的功能和连接。
copy.tagline_en: Extend NanoClaw with new channels, triggers, and integrations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to customize NanoClaw's behavior and add new capabilities.

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会先问清你的需求,再动手改 NanoClaw:加输入渠道、接 MCP 工具、改触发规则、改人设或调整部署。它会在正确的层面改,并告诉你如何验证结果。
howto.when: 当你想给 NanoClaw 增加或修改能力时接管,比如加 Telegram、Slack 等输入渠道、加集成、改触发规则或 router。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 加一个 Telegram 输入渠道
say.note: 它会先问挂到哪个 agent group、怎么隔离

say.text: 把这个渠道的触发规则改成只响应被 @ 的消息
say.note: 改的是 wiring 的 trigger 规则

say.text: 给某个 agent group 加一个日历 MCP 工具
say.note: 会接 MCP server 并让凭据走 OneCLI

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude first asks what you want, then adds capabilities or changes NanoClaw behavior: new input channels, MCP integrations, trigger rules, persona, or deployment. It edits the right layer and tells you how to verify.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to add or change NanoClaw capabilities, such as adding input channels (Telegram, Slack, etc.), adding integrations, changing triggers, or modifying the router.

say_en.text: Add Telegram as an input channel for NanoClaw
say_en.note: It first asks which agent group and isolation level

say_en.text: Change this channel's trigger rule to only respond when @-mentioned
Add a calendar MCP tool to one agent group
say_en.note: Wires the MCP server with credentials via OneCLI
